definitions.explanation: The activity of sewing by hand, or the items being sewn. Refers to practical sewing rather than decorative embroidery.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{縫|ぬ}い{物|もの}が{得意|とくい}だ。
examples.english: My mother is good at sewing.

examples.japanese: {夜|よる}になると{縫|ぬ}い{物|もの}をして{過|す}ごす。
examples.english: I spend my evenings doing needlework.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{目|め}が{悪|わる}くなって、{縫|ぬ}い{物|もの}ができなくなったと{嘆|なげ}いている。
examples.english: My grandmother laments that her eyesight has gotten worse and she can no longer do sewing.

notes:
A compound of {縫|ぬ}う (to sew) and {物|もの} (thing). Refers both to the activity of hand sewing and to the items being sewn. Has a warm, domestic connotation.

USAGE:
Typically refers to hand sewing done at home, including mending clothes, making simple garments, or hemming. More everyday and informal than {裁縫|さいほう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縫|ぬ}い{物|もの}をする — to do sewing
- {縫|ぬ}い{物|もの}が{得意|とくい} — to be good at sewing
- {縫|ぬ}い{物|もの}{道具|どうぐ} — sewing supplies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {裁縫|さいほう} — sewing, needlework (more formal, broader scope)
- {手芸|しゅげい} — handicrafts (broader, includes knitting, crochet, etc.)
- {刺繍|ししゅう} — embroidery (decorative stitching)
